content:
{
  "root_cause": "The pikaday calendar renders focusable buttons (month navigation, day picks) that are inserted into the tab order after the input field. When the calendar is open, pressing Tab moves focus to the first focusable element inside the calendar instead of advancing to the next form field, trapping keyboard users.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add a case for the Tab key (keyCode 9) in pikaday's _onKeyChange handler that hides the calendar (this.hide()) before allowing the default Tab behavior to proceed, thus removing the calendar's focusable elements from the tab order and letting focus shift to the next field.",
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "After entering a date and pressing Tab, focus will move to the guests input, enabling keyboard-only users to continue filling the form without being trapped in the date picker.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Hiding the calendar on Tab could conceal it if a user attempted to navigate the calendar with Tab (though calendar navigation relies on arrow keys, not Tab).",
    "Ensure that hiding does not interfere with other keyboard shortcuts (arrow keys, Enter, Escape) which remain functional."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Pressing Tab after typing a valid date moves focus to the guests field.",
    "The calendar is closed (hidden) when Tab is pressed.",
    "Arrow keys, Enter, and Escape continue to work as expected for date selection and calendar dismissal.",
    "Typing a date and pressing Enter still selects the date and closes the calendar as before."
  ]
}
